0022600165.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (2-4, 11th in the West) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (6-0, 1st in the West), who are unbeaten and riding a six-game win streak, while New Orleans is 0-2 on the road and has won its last two games. For New Orleans, Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise) are out, and Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with a knee issue and is a game-time decision. For Memphis, Quinten Post (ankle) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness) are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions.
